Ministry of Land Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2022/HW/272. Divisional Secretary's Ref. No. : R/Dev/LA/OCH/240. By virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460), I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other Oﬃ cer authorised by him referred to in Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take immediate possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of that Schedule.
K.D. Lൺඅ Kൺඇඍඁൺ, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,"Mihikatha Madura", Land Secretariate,1200/6, Rajamalwaththa Road, Battaramulla.08th January, 2025
